notes.title: new game announced
notes.content:
I decided to make a new game
   it will certainly be different from all my past games,
The game will be about creating your own farm on the islands
  the world will be fictional, you can relax and enjoy the beautiful music and beautiful views, the game will be stylized, a little humor
In the game, you have to set up your own farm on the island, plant various crops and sell crops.
 buy new tools build your own small village soon it will be on steam and you
 you can add it to your wishlist

notes.title: Second update
notes.content:
Hello everyone who reads this, I finally finished 2 updates
-Thanks to the reviews, I found several bugs, and fixed them, thanks to everyone who leaves a review, you are very helpful to me in the development of the project))

[b]and so what is included in the update[/b]
-Completely rewrote 3 missions, now items will spawn 100%, but now they are in other places
-Reworked the radar, I rewrote the radar now it works differently, all objects are highlighted through the walls, this is done for those who cannot find objects)))
-added thunder and lightning to add atmosphere
-also fixed some bugs

notes.title: First update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, today I decided to make an update after yesterday's release, some bug fixes and errors were found, I tried to change them so that you enjoy the scariest horror[/b]
[u]List of changes[/u]
-Fixed a bug where the last mission was faulty
-AI Clown pipu has been improved now he will definitely not leave you alone, always be on the alert
-added a radar button that highlights all items with which you can interact
-fixed some bugs
-changed some settings

notes.title: Pyramid Rush
notes.content:
Pyramid Rush- is diverse puzzle-platformer, that constantly breaks the fourth wall. Resolve physics-based puzzles, go through challenging platformer levels and beat bosses! This game was intended to be a simple "Indiana Jones" rip-off, but something went wrong and it is YOUR mission to fix the game!
